photos.title: Cherry Blossoms in the Shopping Street
photos.caption: Walking through Shibuya, Tokyo and finding these in front of a hairdresser really made me feel like I'm not in the middle of a mega city

photos.title: Nissan R34
photos.caption: Only knew this one from the movies. Godzilla. A car I always wanted to see.

photos.title: A little park with a lot of fishes
photos.caption: Stumbled upon this park after having one of the best sandwiches of my life. It was so quiet, while being only one block away from the main road.

photos.title: Signs in the dark
photos.caption: I bought a new camera and lens in Japan and wanted to take pictures in all possible settings to see how different settings behave. This one was quite a challenge because it turned out very different than on the one-time-use film camera we had bought at some store.

photos.title: Some random restaurant's front
photos.caption: I felt like this was quite the nice restaurant's front door since it really encapsulates the kind of street restaurant I had imagined so many times before.

photos.title: Dilly Dally Bar.
photos.caption: The bar we went to for our last two evenings in Tokyo, before going home. The staff was really nice, and not only because they had to. A bar worth one last beer in Tokyo.

photos.title: Busy sideroad before the storm
photos.caption: We were walking under a bridge in Tokyo and saw this food alleyway which seemed to go on forever. This worker was bringing barrels of beer to the food places down the road.

photos.title: Rainy evening in Tokyo
photos.caption: The very first day we arrived in Tokyo, it rained the whole time. We still wanted to take a stroll through our neighborhood and take a look at the quieter part of Tokyo. I saw that phone booth and had my friend pose in it for the picture.
